title: Transaction Fee Tariff — Corporate Travel Programmes
content:
The Corporate Travel Programmes carry a transaction fee for each booking made through the programme, and the amount of that fee depends on the tier held, on the channel the booking was made through, and on the product it was made for. This tariff publishes those amounts for every tier, together with the amounts charged for the services that are priced on their own rather than as ordinary bookings. All figures are in United States dollars.

## Fees by booking channel and by ticket handling

| Programme tier | Online tool booking | Service desk booking | After-hours booking | Ticket rework | Refund processing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 7.50 | 39.00 | 65.00 | 29.00 | 29.00 |
| Business Team Programme | 6.50 | 34.00 | 59.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Business Pro Programme | 5.50 | 29.00 | 52.00 | 22.00 | 22.00 |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 4.50 | 25.00 | 45.00 | 18.00 | 18.00 |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 3.50 | 21.00 | 39.00 | 15.00 | 15.00 |
| Business Global Programme | 2.50 | 18.00 | 32.00 | 12.00 | 12.00 |

The online figure is the transaction fee for a booking made in the online tool; the service desk figure is the transaction fee for a booking made through the service desk; the after-hours figure is the transaction fee for a booking made outside business hours. Ticket rework is the programme fee for reworking an issued ticket and refund processing is the programme fee for processing a refund.

## Fees by product and by separately priced service

| Programme tier | Hotel booking | Car booking | Rail booking | Group booking | Visa and documentation, per traveller | Report outside the standard suite |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Business Starter Programme | 6.00 | 5.00 | 6.50 | 125.00 | 95.00 | 450.00 |
| Business Team Programme | 5.25 | 4.50 | 5.75 | 110.00 | 85.00 | 350.00 |
| Business Pro Programme | 4.50 | 4.00 | 5.00 | 95.00 | 75.00 | 250.00 |
| Business Enterprise Programme | 3.75 | 3.50 | 4.25 | 80.00 | 65.00 | 150.00 |
| Business Enterprise Plus Programme | 3.00 | 3.00 | 3.50 | 65.00 | 55.00 | 0.00 |
| Business Global Programme | 2.25 | 2.25 | 2.75 | 50.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |

The group figure is the transaction fee for a group booking handled by the group desk; the visa figure is the charge for the programme's visa and documentation service per traveller; the report figure is the charge for a report built outside the standard suite.

## Notes to the tariff

- Within every tier the online tool figure is the lowest of the three channel figures and the after-hours figure the highest, so no tier is quoted an after-hours amount below its own online amount.
- The ticket rework figure and the refund processing figure are equal within each of the six tiers, but they price two different pieces of handling and are published separately.
- Two tiers publish nil for a report outside the standard suite and one publishes nil for the visa and documentation service; a nil figure is a published amount of this tariff like any other.
